title: 第9章 遭遇第10章 改变
content_zh:
金镖武馆的正厅内，成功“入静”
的赵晨在和师傅、师兄分享了一番自己的“入静”
心得后，见黄显钧的心情似乎不错，这才试探着询问道：
“师傅，法术是只有‘法力’境界的高人才能使用吗？”
他想弄清楚将原主诅咒而死的方虚子到底是什么层次的修为。
“正经的法术，确实是得‘法力’境界才能修成，但一些粗浅术法却是连神婆村汉都可能耍上一两手，只不过后面这类法术难练易破，禁忌很多，大部分用黑狗血、童子尿就能破去，没什么价值。”
说到这里，黄显钧看了赵晨一眼，似乎怕这个徒弟走上邪路，又继续道，“你是见我比武时使用的那道‘金镖’法术才想询问的吧？但我的情况并不一样。
“为师当初也是‘禹王宗’里的头面人物，年纪轻轻就凝练了十多道本命法术，而‘金镖’只是其中最不起眼，威力最差的一道。
“但在为师铸成大错，被废除修为逐出师门后，保留下来还能使用的也只剩下了这道‘金镖’法术。
“可即便如此，以现在的身体催动‘法术’，为师也要付出不小的代价，这也是为师最后落败的原因。
“曾经正经修成的法术尚且如此，更别提那些依靠种种外物，强行施展的术法！
“一旦破了禁忌……哦，所谓‘禁忌’就是强行修炼术法时需要避免的一些情况，有的术法就要求使用者不能吃牛羊肉，有的则要求必须常年泡在海里，不一而足……而一旦破了禁忌，或者遭到反噬，施术者立刻死亡都是轻的……甚至可能化作怪物或邪祟！”
“怪物？邪祟？”
赵晨闻言吃了一惊，没想到术法失败反噬的后遗症那么大。
“因为很多术法的源头很可能来自邪魔，破了禁忌或遭遇反噬后，术会反向吞噬主人，向邪魔转化……至于邪魔是什么，还不是你现在该知道的。”
顿了顿，黄显钧馆主再次郑重强调道，“总之，法力境之前，最好不要去碰触法术！
如果需要战斗，用火铳难道不好吗？那威力比起半吊子的术法强多了。”
确实，枪械能算是强力的远程攻击“法术”
了！
心里虽然极为认同，但赵晨还是假装不死心地追问道：

“难道没有例外？真的没有真气或炼窍就能用的法术？”
“自然是有例外的，有一些类法术的能力，或者说‘异能’虽然比不上正经法术的威力，但使用起来表面上确实没什么限制……不过，实际上可能比禁忌需要付出的代价还要大得多！”
说到这里，黄显钧难得地板起面孔，冷笑了一声。
见师傅的情绪似乎有些不对，赵晨识趣地没有再问，而是转移开话题，说起了原主在修习“太乙五行拳”
时遇到的一些疑难，结果一一得到了师傅和师兄的指点。
等问题都被解决，师傅也端起了茶杯后，赵晨方才主动提出告辞，到门口汇合了又探听了一肚子八卦的小厮风曲，离开了武馆。
三师兄冯仓一路将小师弟送到武馆门口，然后才反身回到正厅，疑惑地对师傅道：“师傅，真的有必要将那么珍贵的法门给小师弟吗？以您的实力，想要避开视线，独自去往郡城应该相当容易，而只要您没事，沙蛇帮也不敢对我和师弟们怎么样……
“现在多了一支火铳队护送，看似安稳，但目标却更大了。”
黄显钧馆主喝了口茶水，摇摇头道：“如果我之前比武没使用‘金镖’，那你说的确实没错……但以这废功之躯强行动用本命法术，必然会折损我的气数，虽然要不了多久就能恢复，但最近半个月运气怕是会很糟……所以才不得不借助你小师弟家里的势力护送。
“左右不过是一本传播很广的秘籍，有价值的还是我自己的‘翻译注解’，给了他倒也没什么，就当日后两家合作的诚意了。
“不过，你这位小师弟天赋极佳，未来很可能走到法术境。
所以才多提点了他几句，免得1他走上邪路。”
“原来如此……”
冯仓恍然，继而笑着道，“师傅，我还以为你会将小师弟介绍给‘禹王宗’呢。”
“我‘禹王宗’也不缺一两个修道种子，没必要太过殷勤……
“而且我刚刚提了那么多次，他如果自己想去，自然会去……而我是不会再多介绍人加入宗门了！”
content_en:
In the main hall of the Golden Dart Martial Arts Hall, I successfully "entered silence"
Zhao Chen shared his experience of "entering tranquility" with his master and senior fellow apprentices.
After learning the experience, seeing that Huang Xianjun seemed to be in a good mood, he tentatively asked:
"Master, can spells only be used by experts in the realm of 'mana'?"
He wanted to find out what level of cultivation Fang Xuzi had, who cursed the original owner to death.
"Serious spells can indeed be practiced only if you have a level of 'mana', but some superficial spells can even be mastered by a village man. However, these latter types of spells are difficult to practice and easy to break. There are many taboos. Most of them can be broken with black dog blood or child urine, so they are of little value."
At this point, Huang Xianjun glanced at Zhao Chen, as if he was afraid that this apprentice would go astray, and continued, "You want to ask about it because you saw the 'Golden Dart' spell I used in the competition, right? But my situation is different.
"When I was a master, I was also a prominent figure in the 'Yuwang Sect'. I had condensed more than ten natal spells at a young age, and the 'Golden Dart' was just the most inconspicuous and least powerful one among them.
"But after he made a big mistake for his master and was expelled from the master's sect after his cultivation was abolished, the only thing that remained and could still be used was the 'Golden Dart' spell.
"But even so, using the current body to activate the 'spell' will cost the teacher a lot, which is also the reason why the teacher failed in the end.
"Spells that were once seriously practiced are still like this, let alone those that rely on various external objects to be forcibly performed!
"Once the taboo is broken... Oh, the so-called 'taboos' are some situations that need to be avoided when forcibly practicing spells. Some spells require the user not to eat beef and mutton, and some require that the user must be soaked in the sea all year round, and so on... Once the taboo is broken, or there is a backlash, the user will die immediately... and may even turn into a monster or evil spirit! "
"monster? Evil? "
Zhao Chen was surprised when he heard this. He didn't expect the sequelae of a failed spell to be so serious.
"Because the source of many spells is likely to come from evil spirits. After breaking the taboo or encountering backlash, the spells will reversely devour the owner and transform into evil spirits... As for what evil spirits are, you don't need to know yet. "
After a pause, Hall Master Huang Xianjun solemnly emphasized again, "In short, it is best not to touch magic before entering the magic realm!
If you need to fight, wouldn't it be better to use a firecracker? That power is much stronger than half-baked spells. "
Indeed, firearms can be regarded as powerful long-range attack "spells"
Got it!
Although he agreed with it in his heart, Zhao Chen still pretended not to give up and asked:
"Are there no exceptions? Is there really no magic that can be used by infuriating Qi or refining the orifice? "
"Of course there are exceptions. There are some magic-like abilities, or 'superpowers'. Although they are not as powerful as regular spells, there are indeed no restrictions on their use... However, in fact, the price you need to pay may be much higher than the taboo! "
Having said this, Huang Xianjun rarely raised his face and sneered.
Seeing that the master's mood seemed a little wrong, Zhao Chen wisely did not ask any more questions, but changed the subject and talked about the original master practicing "Taiyi Five Elements Boxing"
Some of the difficulties I encountered during the course were solved one by one by my master and senior brothers.
After all the problems were solved and the master picked up the teacup, Zhao Chen took the initiative to say goodbye, met the young man Fengqu at the door who had listened to a lot of gossip, and left the martial arts hall.
Third senior brother Feng Cang took his junior brother all the way to the entrance of the martial arts school, then turned back to the main hall and asked the master doubtfully: "Master, is it really necessary to give such a precious method to my junior brother? With your strength, it should be quite easy to go to the county alone without being noticed. And as long as you are fine, the Sand Snake Gang will not dare to do anything to me and my junior brothers...
"Now there is an additional fire gun team to escort us. It seems safe, but the target is bigger."
Huang Xianjun PavilionThe Lord took a sip of tea, shook his head and said: "If I didn't use the 'Golden Dart' in the previous competition, then you are indeed right... But using this useless body to forcefully use my own magic will inevitably damage my energy. Although it won't take long to recover, my luck will be very bad in the past half month... That's why I have to rely on the influence of your junior brother's family to escort me.
"Left and Right is just a widely circulated secret book. The most valuable thing is my own 'translation annotations'. It's nothing if I gave it to him. It just shows the sincerity of the future cooperation between the two companies.
“However, your little junior brother is extremely talented and is likely to reach the realm of magic in the future.
That's why I gave him a few more words to prevent him from going astray. "
"That's it..."
Feng Cang suddenly understood, then smiled and said, "Master, I thought you would introduce my junior brother to the 'Yuwang Sect'."
"Our 'Yuwang Sect' does not lack one or two cultivation seeds, so there is no need to be too diligent..."
"And I just mentioned it so many times. If he wants to go, he will naturally go...and I will not introduce any more people to join the sect! "
